reasoning: A hybrid strategy combines autonomous pattern recognition with robust XAI tools to detect shared spurious features. Autonomous reasoning helps identify initial candidates based on raw feature similarities, while XAI tools provide quantitative attribution scores to validate and prioritize features with high influence despite lacking semantic relevance. This approach increases detection accuracy by combining pattern intuition with model-specific feature importance.

tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP and Integrated Gradients provide consistent, model-agnostic feature attributions that highlight high-importance features, even if they are spurious. Sensitivity analysis confirms whether removing a feature significantly alters predictions, thereby validating its role in misclassification. Together, these tools enable detection of shared spurious features that are both influential and semantically irrelevant to malignancy.
